newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZSE to publish brokers' NZSE-10 company forecasts.
newsitem.headline: NZSE to publish brokers' NZSE-10 company forecasts.

text.p: The New Zealand Stock Exchange said on Friday it intended to publish current forecasts from member brokers for the performance of the companies which constitute the NZSE-10 Index.
From this afternoon, the exchange will release a matrix of the forecasts within its weekly diary publication.
"Publication of these forecasts is intended as an additional information service to assist investors and create interest in the market," the exchange said in a statement.
An NZSE spokesman told Reuters it was not the intention to indicate how many member brokers had contributed their data to the forecasts or to identify individual firms' data by source.

The information will set out weekly current data on market price, index weighting and market capitalisation combined with average forecasts of operating profit, earnings per share, price/earnings ratio, gross dividend per share and gross dividend yield.
